Annapurna · Ridge walk

Mardi Himal

Days
5
Highest
4,500 m
Difficulty
Moderate
Season
Spring · Autumn
From
$160 pp

A quieter ridge walk that climbs steadily through rhododendron forest to a high camp with the Annapurna wall filling the sky.

We walk slowly and steadily, every day.

Short stages keep the altitude gain gentle; the last morning is an early start for the base camp viewpoint.

Sketch map, not for navigation · coordinates approximate

Day 2 · Forest Camp → Badal Danda
sleep 3,210 m · 4–5 hrs

A steady climb out of the forest onto the open ridge; the first close view of Machhapuchhre.

ridgeviewpoint
  • Sunrise over the Annapurna wall from High Camp.
  • Rhododendron forest in bloom in spring.

What trekkers say

From the trail

All three

Reviews left on Tripadvisor by travellers Sandip guided during his years with Himalaya Hub Adventure, before he founded Magic Beyond Himalaya.

Sandip was great as a guide. Unfortunately the weather wasn't always on our side but I think Sandip constantly adapted and made safe decisions so we could continue to enjoy the trip.

Nat · Annapurna Circuit + ABC · Dec 2019 · Tripadvisor

The trekking itself was wonderful. Sandip is a young, fun guide who does his work very well.

Frank · Kano, Nigeria · Annapurna Base Camp · Sep 2019 · Tripadvisor

How fit do I need to be?
We walk slowly and steadily, every day. If you can walk for five or six hours with breaks, you can do the shorter treks.
What about altitude sickness?
I carry a first-aid kit and a pulse oximeter.
